### Set parameters for plotting
```{r include = TRUE}
mmjoint_colors <- c("Quiescent" = "#bbdefb", 
                    "Priming_1" =  "#519ec6", 
                    "Priming_2" = "#3971ff",
                    "Activation_1" = "#a9df91", 
                    "Activation_2" = "#7eca72", 
                    "Activation_3" = "#48b352", 
                    "Effector_1" = "#ffb669", 
                    "Effector_2" = "#ff882e", 
                    "Effector-memory_transition_1" = "#cda7c7",
                    "Effector-memory_transition_2" = "#9e79b6",
                    "Effector-memory_transition_3" = "#7c4d9f",
                    "Memory_1" = "#ef999c", 
                    "Memory_2" = "#eb5e63",
                    "Memory_3" = "#e53a46")


color_bach2 <- c(
  "Cxcr6_hi_eff" = "#FF7F00",
  "Cxcr6_lo_eff" = "#DFB462", 
  "Stem_like" = "#35a153"
)

color_bach2oe <- c(
  "Effector" = "#FFB300",
  "Stem_like" = "#35a153"
)


color_group <- c(Ctrl = "#a0c9e5", KO = "#FDC360",
                 pMIG = "#a0c9e5", OE = "#C06CAB")

```



### Bach2 footpringing
```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}

motifPositions <- getPositions(proj)
tf_abbr <- c("Bach2")
markerMotifs <- unlist(lapply(tf_abbr, function(x) grep(x, names(motifPositions), value = TRUE)))
markerMotifs

proj <- addGroupCoverages(proj, groupBy = "cell_module", force = TRUE)

seFoot <- getFootprints(
  ArchRProj = proj, 
  useGroups = c("Quiescent", "Priming_1", "Priming_2", "Activation_1", "Activation_2", 
                "Activation_3", "Effector_1", "Effector_2", "Effector-memory_transition_1", 
                "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3", 
                "Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3"),
  positions = motifPositions[markerMotifs], 
  groupBy = "cell_module"
)

plotFootprints(
  seFoot = seFoot,
  pal = mmjoint_colors,
  ArchRProj = proj, 
  flank = 200,
  flankNorm = 30,
  normMethod = "Subtract",
  plotName =  "Bach2",
  addDOC = FALSE,
  smoothWindow = 5,
  height = 4, width = 3,
  force = TRUE
)

```  

### TF driver plot
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
d <- read_tsv('source_fig_S14c.tsv')

ggplot(data = d, aes(x = Corr, y = Enrichment.log10P, color = isSig)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.01), color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.7, 0.7), color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_point(aes(size = isSig)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray66", "firebrick3")) + 
  scale_size_manual(values = c(1, 3)) +
  labs(y = "Enrichment log10 P", x = "DORC-TF Correlation", title = "Bach2") + 
  ylim(-10, 15) + 
  xlim(-1, 1) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA)) + 
  coord_fixed(2/25) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label), size = 5, color = "black", vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, max.overlaps = 13)

```


### UMAP of Bach2 KO T cells
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
seu <- readRDS('scBach2.RDS')
scplotter::CellDimPlot(seu, group_by = "celltype", reduction = "umap", palcolor = color_bach2)

```

### Dotplot of GEX in Bach2 KO T cells
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=4}
features <-   c("Il2ra", "Tigit", "Cxcr6", "Havcr2", "Batf", "Tox2", "Ccr6", "Pdcd1", "Ccr2", "Klrg1", "Cxcr3", "Ccr5", "Prdm1",
                "Sell", "Ikzf2", "Lef1", "Ccr7", "Satb1", "Sox4", "Myb")
sub_mat <- tibble(as.data.frame(t(seu@assays$RNA@data[features,])))
sub_mat$cluster <- seu$celltype

sub_mat_d <- sub_mat %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%  
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cluster")
orow <- hclust(dist(sub_mat_d, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D")
ocol <- hclust(dist(t(sub_mat_d), method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D")

sub_mat_mean <- sub_mat %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%  
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "gene", values_to = "mean") %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(mean_zs = scale(mean))
sub_mat_prop <- sub_mat %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%  
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  ~ sum(.x > 0)/n())) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "gene", values_to = "prop")
sub_mat_mean$prop <- sub_mat_prop$prop
sub_mat_mean$gene <- factor(sub_mat_mean$gene, levels = features[ocol$order])
sub_mat_mean$cluster <- factor(sub_mat_mean$cluster, levels = unique(sub_mat_mean$cluster)[orow$order])

ggplot(sub_mat_mean, aes(y = gene, x = cluster)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = prop, color = mean_zs)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5)) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rev(choose_colorset("solar_dim")), 
                        limits = c(-2, 2),
                        oob = scales::oob_squish) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, title = "Z-score",
                                theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", face = "italic"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13))
    

```

### Barplot of cluster distribution of Bach2 KO T cells
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}

data <- seu@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(group, celltype) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Stem_like")

ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = prop, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge', width = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(color_group)) +
  xlab(NULL)


data <- seu@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(group, celltype) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(celltype != "Stem_like") %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(prop = sum(prop))

ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = prop, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge', width = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(color_group)) +
  xlab(NULL)


  
```
